function.name: Menu_PrepareOptionsScreen
function.body: Copies the caller-selected VDP block, clears VRAM C000 and E000, clears the active palette, copies the fixed scene plane at 0x00129F00 to VRAM F800, then branches on 0x00FFF157. The zero path renders the ROM prompt at 0x00126679 at (14,16); the nonzero path renders the difficulty label through Menu_RenderDifficultyLabel and renders the ROM prompt at 0x001266A0 at (10,14).
function.effect: Builds the startup/options menu presentation and leaves the adjacent selection-marker helpers to update actor positions.

relationships.difficulty_renderer: The nonzero presentation path calls Menu_RenderDifficultyLabel at 0x001B434E.
relationships.command_renderer: Both text paths call SceneResource_ProcessCommandStream at 0x001B21F6 with the corresponding ROM text source and screen coordinates.
relationships.next_function: The exact range ends immediately before Menu_SetPrimarySelectionMarkerPosition at 0x001B43C4.

limitations: The current whole-ROM export reports no direct static caller for this helper; it may be reached through a menu state table or an indirect presentation path.
The semantic role of the 0x00FFF157 gate is bounded to its two rendered menu phases but is not promoted to a tracked RAM symbol here.
